_readme: Phase 1 — Source catalogue. We list candidate OPEN sources BEFORE fetching anything. trust_level: high=official/govt, medium=major news/big directory, low=small blog. access_method: how we would read it. update_frequency: how often it changes. respect_robots: we honour robots.txt and only automate sources that permit it. Each source has an id referenced by dataset records in source_links[].

areas_wards_villages.name: Census 2011 — Vadodara city / district ward & population tables
areas_wards_villages.notes: Ward-level names + population. Static (2011) but authoritative baseline.

areas_wards_villages.name: Vadodara Municipal Corporation (VMC) — zones & wards
areas_wards_villages.notes: Official zone/ward structure. Post-2021 reconstitution: 4 zones, 19 wards. Confirm current count at time of use.

areas_wards_villages.name: VUDA — Development Plan village/locality maps
areas_wards_villages.notes: Named villages/localities inside the urban development authority boundary.

areas_wards_villages.name: LocalBodyData — VMC ward numbers + LGD codes
areas_wards_villages.notes: Cross-reference ward numbers and Local Government Directory (LGD) codes.

areas_wards_villages.name: India Post — PIN code directory (Vadodara)
areas_wards_villages.notes: Authoritative PIN codes per locality/post office.

services.name: Justdial — Vadodara category listings
services.notes: Large directory. HEAVY anti-bot + robots restrictions — only use where permitted; treat phone numbers as leads (no auto-publish).

services.name: Sulekha — Vadodara services
services.notes: Services/professionals. Same consent rule: numbers are leads, not public contacts.

services.name: OpenStreetMap — Overpass API (shops/amenities in Vadodara)
services.notes: OPEN, license-friendly (ODbL, attribution required). Best first source for names + coordinates + category. Rarely has ratings.

services.name: Chamber-of-commerce / trade-body member PDFs
services.notes: Member firm lists as structured PDF tables.

news_events.name: Times of India — Vadodara city section
news_events.notes: Prefer RSS where available (cheapest, cleanest). Major-source corroboration for event 'confirmed' status.

news_events.name: Indian Express — Gujarat / Vadodara
news_events.notes: Second independent major source for cross-validation.

news_events.name: Gujarat Samachar — Vadodara (Gujarati)
news_events.notes: Gujarati-language coverage; useful for hyperlocal events national press misses.

travel_nearby.name: Gujarat Tourism — official portal
travel_nearby.notes: Official descriptions + how-to-reach for regional spots.

travel_nearby.name: Vadodara District — tourism / places of interest
travel_nearby.notes: Government district page; authoritative for nearby attractions.

travel_nearby.name: Travel blogs / guides (Vadodara & nearby)
travel_nearby.notes: Mood/vibe descriptions. Low trust — must be corroborated by >=1 higher-trust source before a trip_spot is accepted.
